canonical.title: IT Conferences and Tech Events in Cáceres

siblings.title: Things to do in Cáceres
siblings.summary: A weekend playbook for Cáceres: the UNESCO walled old town, museums, viewpoints, Game-of-Thrones lanes, day trips, and what to eat around your Michelin dinner.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Cáceres
siblings.summary: Atrio is the only Michelin-starred restaurant in Cáceres city — it holds 3 stars. There are no 2-star restaurants in the region.

sources.title: Potencial Digital 2026 — Official Site
sources.claim: Potencial Digital 2026 is the 3rd Extremaduran Congress on Digital Transformation, AI, Cybersecurity and Robotics, Sep 24-25 at Palacio de Congresos de Cáceres, free admission

sources.title: Junta de Extremadura — Congreso Digital
sources.claim: Potencial Digital I (Sep 2024) drew 6,000+ visitors, 61 speakers, 50+ sponsors, with 14% of attending job-seekers hired on the spot

sources.title: Extremadura Digital Day 2026 — Eventbrite
sources.claim: Extremadura Digital Day 2026 on Oct 3 at Complejo Cultural San Francisco, Cáceres; tickets Early Bird €30, General €40

sources.title: Mobbeel Innovation Challenge 2025
sources.claim: Mobbeel Innovation Challenge 2nd edition (Oct 23 2025) ran at Garaje 2.0, Cáceres, free no-code hackathon with 100+ participants and €500 max prize per team

sources.title: JITEL 2025 — Actas UEX
sources.claim: JITEL 2025 (XVII edition) held Nov 12-14 2025 in Cáceres at UEX with 79 accepted papers

sources.title: AEXTIC — ExtreTech
sources.claim: AEXTIC runs ExtreTech thematic sessions across Cáceres province on cybersecurity, AI, and digital transformation for SMEs

sources.title: IV Hackathon Open Data Cáceres
sources.claim: Open Data Cáceres Hackathon had at least four editions (last known Nov 2018) at Escuela Politécnica de Cáceres

sources.title: FUNDECYT-PCTEX — Incubator Network
sources.claim: FUNDECYT-PCTEX operates the Science and Technology Park of Extremadura and a distributed incubator network on the UEX campus in Cáceres

sources.title: COMPUTAEX / CénitS — Events
sources.claim: COMPUTAEX/CénitS is the regional HPC centre in Cáceres offering free specialized training in AI, HPC and quantum computing

sources.title: EDIH Tech4Efficiency
sources.claim: EDIH Tech4Efficiency (European Digital Innovation Hub for Extremadura) launched with €2M EC funding

sources.title: GDG Cáceres — Meetup
sources.claim: GDG Cáceres has 399 members on Meetup but has been dormant since its last event in February 2019

sources.title: NovaCiencia — Grados UEX 2026/27
sources.claim: Universidad de Extremadura approved new degrees in Computer Engineering and Telecommunication Technologies at the Cáceres campus starting 2026/27
